title: The Plaguebringer
description:
I always really liked playing The Silent with Poison, so that was the main inspiration for this character.

The Plaguebringer is built around a similar slower, stacking damage mechanic with a plague doctor theme. Infect enemies, build the sickness over time, and use defensive and utility cards to survive while the infection gets worse.

I've tried to give the character a few different ways to build so you aren't forced into the same playstyle every run.

[b]FEATURES[/b]
- Custom playable character
- Full custom card pool
- Plague mechanic
- Specimen secondary resource
- Sway and Off Balance debuffs
- Custom relics and powers
- Multiple build paths including Plague, Specimens, Exhaust and surgical attacks

[b]MECHANICS[/b]
[b]Plague[/b] - Deals damage equal to its stacks at the start of the affected creature's turn, ignores Block, then grows by 15%, rounded up.
[b]Specimen[/b] - A persistent secondary resource used by its own cards and build paths.
[b]Sway[/b] - Reduces enemy Attack damage by 10% per stack, up to 5 stacks.
[b]Off Balance[/b] - Applying Sway also applies an equal amount of Off Balance for that turn. Attackers gain Block equal to Off Balance when they deal unblocked Attack damage to that creature.

[b]FEEDBACK & TESTING[/b]
The mod is still being actively balanced and bug tested.

Feedback is very welcome. If something feels too strong, too weak or broken, please let me know. I'm happy to listen to suggestions and incorporate improvements where they fit.

There will be more fixes, balance changes and improvements as the mod develops.

Requires BaseLib.

[b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
Some artwork in this mod was generated using OpenAI/ChatGPT. AI tools were also used to assist with programming and debugging.

[b]SOURCE[/b]
